subject: planner: fix idxMergePartPlans forget to deal with RootTaskConds (#58507)
summary: Diff is small and planner-only: it moves `CopTask.convertToRootTaskImpl()`’s `handleRootTaskConds()` call in the IndexMerge branch to *after* the optional extra Projection, preventing `rootTaskConds` (virtual-column filters that must run in TiDB) from being dropped when `needExtraProj` is true. Added regression test `TestIssue58476` covering IndexMerge + virtual generated column filter + HAVING disjunction; without the fix the WHERE filter would be lost and results could be incorrect. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: the same ordering (projection first, then `handleRootTaskConds`) remains after refactors (moved into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop/task_base.go`), so no later revert/fix indicates a remaining Blocker/High issue.
